_note: 2014 backgrounds grant fixed skills and no ability score increases. The absence of an 'ability' grant here — versus data/2024/backgrounds.json, which is full of them — is the entire edition difference. No engine code is aware of it.

grants.name: Military Rank
grants.text: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former military organization still recognize your authority and influence.

grants.name: Shelter of the Faithful
grants.text: You and your adventuring companions can expect to receive free healing and care at a temple, shrine, or other established presence of your faith.
